description: Edit server settings: name, description, icon, banner, invite background, AFK behavior, system and rules channels, verification level, explicit media filter, and default notifications. Images come from public URLs. Only passed fields change. Descriptions need a Community server; the banner and invite background need boosts. A lower verification level, a weaker media filter, or turning Community off lowers the server's protection, so that needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Raising them, and every other setting, happens at once.

afk_channel.description: Voice channel name or ID, or none to clear.

banner_url.description: Public URL of the banner shown at the top of the channel list, or none. Needs boost level 2.

community.description: Enable or disable the Community feature. Enabling needs rules_channel and public_updates_channel.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

default_notifications.description: What new members are notified of by default.

discovery_background_url.description: Public URL of the Server Discovery background, or none. Needs a discoverable server.

explicit_media_filter.description: Which members' images Discord scans for explicit content.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

icon_url.description: Public URL of the new server icon (png, jpeg, gif, webp), or none to remove it. A gif needs the animated icon feature.

invite_background_url.description: Public URL of the invite page background (the splash), or none. Needs boost level 1.

public_updates_channel.description: Text channel for Discord's mod updates, when enabling Community.

rules_channel.description: Text channel for the rules, when enabling Community.

system_channel.description: Channel for join notices, or none to clear.

name: update_server
title: Update server
